# suite  path
# A changed file matches when its path starts with the path.
# notifiers_common runs the email, telegram and ntfy suites.
# shared runs every suite.
# Several lines with the same suite name are alternatives.

subscription boomerang/services/subscription/
alert_engine boomerang/services/alert_engine/
email boomerang/services/notifiers/email/
telegram boomerang/services/notifiers/telegram/
ntfy boomerang/services/notifiers/ntfy/
notifiers_common boomerang/services/notifiers/common/

shared boomerang/core/
shared boomerang/testing/
shared boomerang/__init__.py
shared packages/boomerang-contracts/
shared pyproject.toml
shared poetry.lock
shared Makefile
shared stack/
shared docker-compose
shared Dockerfile
shared docker/
